name: Static auth app access token
description: A static access token, found in app settings, that a project-based app configured for static auth uses as a Bearer token in a single authorized account.

blockers.summary: HubSpot shows only a masked placeholder and states no prefix, alphabet, length or grouping; the relation to legacy private app tokens is not stated.
The token's string form would need an issued static auth token, which is not created here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
